description: This file defines the EntityFormInterface interface for entity form classes in Drupal, specifying methods for handling entity operations, form building, and dependencies.

classes.name: EntityFormInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity form classes, defining methods for setting and getting operations, entities, and dependencies, as well as building and saving entities.

methods.name: setOperation
methods.description: Sets the current operation for the form.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Gets the form entity used for populating form defaults.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the form entity to operate upon.

methods.name: getEntityFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Determines the entity from a route match.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Builds an updated entity object based on submitted form values.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for saving the entity.
